text_en: I'm a little busy. Do you mind?
I see that the commander has brought you the orb.
You can learn a lot from observing. We know we could count on you, little man.
You must know someone in the city who is capable of doing it.
We are not particularly... adept... at dealing with small people.
The Commander made great efforts in asking you for help, don't think it was easy for him.
Do not worry, I will protect the beacon. The last thing we need is more intruders getting inside.
